seo.metaTitle: Document & image compare — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Overlay two versions of a document, contract or image to spot differences. Changed text, numbers or pixels are highlighted in red. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/vellum-diff-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Document & image compare processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/vellum-diff-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Document & image compare upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Document & image compare executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/vellum-diff-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Document & image compare upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Document & image compare executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/vellum-diff-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Document & image compare?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/vellum_diff.json or open /tools/vellum-diff?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
